verdict.rationale: ADK's own Callbacks feature lets developers hook into specific agent-lifecycle events and run custom side-effects automatically. The Workflow Runtime adds deterministic routing that can act as conditional logic. This is code-level hooking into internal execution events, not a rule system triggered by external events. Missing for 10: declarative rule definitions, triggers on external or business events (e.g. incoming messages, schedules, data changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Callbacks: Hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle to add logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects without altering core agent logic.
Workflow Runtime: A graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic execution flows for agentic apps, with support for routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management
